name: FnB OS V1 — Approval and Publishing Gate [SKELETON]

parameters.content:
## PHASE 8 SKELETON — DO NOT ACTIVATE

**active: false** — This workflow must remain inactive until:
1. All REPLACE_WITH_* credential placeholders are replaced with real credentials
2. Webhook path is configured and secured
3. Owner has reviewed and approved the workflow
4. Codex has reviewed and issued PASS

**THIS IS THE APPROVAL GATE:**
All items must pass through this workflow before ANY publishing action.
Only items with approval_status='Approved' (set by Owner) proceed.
All publishing nodes are NoOp stubs — permanently disabled in skeleton.

**HARD CONSTRAINTS:**
- NO auto-publishing to any platform
- Only approval_status='Approved' items can reach publish path (currently all stubs)
- No Meta / TikTok / Zalo / Telegram API call in skeleton
- No ads budget committed
- No customer messages sent
- Logging step is mandatory at every approval decision
- Only Owner (Bo Bao) can set approval_status=Approved

**Schema:** schemas/approval-status.schema.json
**Blueprint:** runtime-blueprints/n8n/approval-gate-blueprint.md
**Blueprint:** docs/19_APPROVAL_GATE_RUNTIME_DESIGN.md
**Phase:** 8 — n8n Importable Workflow Skeletons
**Status:** SKELETON_IMPORTABLE — NOT PRODUCTION READY

nodes.name: Webhook: Receive Approval Request
nodes.notes: Placeholder webhook — configure path after Owner review. Requires secure authentication in production. Do not expose to public internet without auth.

nodes.name: If: Is Approved
nodes.notes: TRUE = approved — route to item type switch for publish path (all stubs). FALSE = not approved — route to block message.

assignments.name: block_reason
assignments.value: MISSING_APPROVAL — item cannot proceed to publish path

assignments.name: next_action
assignments.value: Owner must set approval_status=Approved and owner_decision=Approved before this item can proceed.

parameters.errorMessage: MISSING_APPROVAL — Publishing blocked. Item does not have Owner-approved status. No content published, no messages sent, no ads spent. Owner action required.

nodes.name: Switch: Item Type
nodes.notes: Routes approved items by item_type to per-module publishing stubs. All publish nodes are NoOp in skeleton.

nodes.name: NoOp: STUB — Publish Content to Platform
nodes.notes: STUB DISABLED — PRODUCTION: Replace with Facebook / Instagram / TikTok / Zalo publish node. Requires REPLACE_WITH_PLATFORM_CREDENTIAL. No auto-publishing in skeleton.

nodes.name: NoOp: STUB — Archive Creative Brief
nodes.notes: STUB DISABLED — PRODUCTION: Replace with Google Drive or Supabase node to archive approved creative brief. Requires REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_DRIVE_CREDENTIAL.

nodes.name: NoOp: STUB — Launch Ads Campaign
nodes.notes: STUB DISABLED — PRODUCTION: Replace with Meta Ads / TikTok Ads node. Requires REPLACE_WITH_META_ADS_CREDENTIAL or REPLACE_WITH_TIKTOK_ADS_CREDENTIAL. CRITICAL: No ads spend committed in skeleton.

nodes.name: NoOp: STUB — Send CRM Messages
nodes.notes: STUB DISABLED — PRODUCTION: Replace with Zalo / Facebook Messenger / SMS node. Requires REPLACE_WITH_MESSAGING_CREDENTIAL. CRITICAL: No messages sent to real customers in skeleton.

nodes.name: NoOp: STUB — Post Reply to Channel
nodes.notes: STUB DISABLED — PRODUCTION: Replace with Facebook / Instagram / TikTok comment reply node. Requires REPLACE_WITH_PLATFORM_CREDENTIAL. CRITICAL: No auto-reply to real customers in skeleton.
